svg.aria-label: MEDSYS: DICOM to 3D medical imaging platform. Modality-aware routing across CT/MRI/PET, dual segmentation engines (intensity heuristics + TotalSegmentator/nnU-Net), MedSAM refinement, in-browser rendering via three.js. Dice 0.95 · IoU 0.91 on lung segmentation vs the deep-learning reference.
